# High Roller Technologies Announces ROLR™ Prediction Markets Platform Commercial Launch Timing


September 02, 2026 7:52 am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_d48d5b1d7d11dbbd9888f539355c5fe5/highroller/news/2026-09-02_High_Roller_Technologies_Announces_ROLR_163.pdf)


- *Invitation-only platform launch planned for September 15*
- *Full commercial launch, open to the public, targeted by the end of October*


**LAS VEGAS, Nevada, Sept. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --** High Roller Technologies, Inc. ("High Roller" or the "Company") (NYSE: ROLR), a publicly traded online gaming and prediction markets company, today announced the invitation-only launch timing of its ROLR™ prediction markets platform on September 15, 2026, followed by a public commercial launch targeted by the end of October 2026.


“Our beta launch is an important strategic milestone that will move ROLR from development and integration into controlled, real-world use,” said Seth Young, Chief Executive Officer of High Roller Technologies. “Invited participants will experience the first iteration of our flagship U.S. product from onboarding through contract settlement. The data and feedback generated during this phase will allow us to refine the experience, validate our operating processes and prepare for our planned commercial launch in October.”


“Our focus during the weeks following the controlled launch will be on sharpening the product for our planned public commercial launch,” Young continued. “We plan to iterate upon our initial product launch rapidly thereafter, and we are incredibly excited to welcome our first traders to ROLR.”


**Beta Platform Capabilities and Experience**


During the closed beta, invited participants will use the platform under controlled, live-platform conditions, enabling High Roller to collect operating data, evaluate user behavior and obtain direct feedback before expanding access to the broader market. The Company expects to use the beta period to validate and optimize the customer experience while confirming platform stability, scalability and seamless operational readiness. The closed beta is not open to the general public.


**Closed Beta Objectives**


The closed beta will assess key elements of the ROLR platform and customer experience, including:


- Account-registration and onboarding completion rates;
- Identity-verification and geolocation performance;
- Deposit, funding and withdrawal processes;
- Market discovery, navigation and user engagement;
- Order-entry performance, transaction execution and platform responsiveness;
- Trading patterns, market participation and repeat engagement;
- Contract resolution, settlement and account reconciliation;
- Customer-service inquiries, response times and resolution rates;
- Compliance controls and exception-handling procedures; and
- Overall platform reliability, scalability and user experience.


The beta will initially be limited to select invited participants. High Roller expects to evaluate the resulting data and feedback on an ongoing basis and make targeted product and operational refinements before the planned commercial launch.


High Roller currently expects to commence the commercial launch of the ROLR prediction markets platform by the end of October 2026, subject to the successful completion of the closed beta and final technical and operational readiness.
